changelog:
Restore your setup on a new phone from a backup, starting on the very first screen.

WHAT CHANGED

- Settings, Backup & Restore has Restore from a backup. Pick a backup file and the app shows what it will add and what it will replace before anything changes. Then choose everything, sources only, or settings only.
- The first screen on a new install welcomes you and offers Restore from a backup beside Add a source, so you do not have to add a source you do not want first.
- A file that is cut short, is not a backup, or was made by a newer version is refused with a clear message, and nothing on the phone is changed.
- Settings from an older backup that no longer fit are adjusted to the nearest allowed value rather than rejected.
- A backup without passwords never removes the logins you already have. A panel added from it stays switched off until you enter its password.
- Category choices for sources whose channels have not arrived yet are remembered and applied automatically after the first refresh.
- When the restore finishes, it says exactly what it did, including anything still waiting.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else, including exporting a backup and sending the log.

NOT YET

- Favourites and watch history are not in backups yet.
